items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I played a gig a couple of months ago and some woman said to me, “We want to hear those older songs, those Rod Stewart songs.” [INTERVIEWEE] Right. There’s another one. I didn’t mention him, should have.

ctx.x: Well it does. That’s what I’m saying. These business, Harvard business graduates, they learn to sell anything. So why do they want to deal with temperamental quality? Or maybe not even temperamental, they don’t know. They were trained in business. They weren’t trained in music. So maybe they like, maybe they think the sun sets with Bruce Springsteen.
What’s your — I played a gig a couple of months ago and some woman said to me, “We want to hear those older songs, those Rod Stewart songs.”
Right. There’s another one. I didn’t mention him, should have.
